description: Defines a readonly struct InvokableMethodId used to identify an invokable method within the Orleans code generation framework. The struct encapsulates proxy base information, method symbol, and interface type, providing equality and hashing functionality.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides object.Equals; checks if object is InvokableMethodId and compares for equality.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on proxy base, method, and interface type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation combining proxy base, interface type name, and method name.
